name: Commission for the Arts Special Meeting
agenda_text:
City of Encinitas
Commission for the Arts Special Meeting
AGENDA
SEPTEMBER 12, 2022 -
02:30 PM
City of Encinitas - Council Chambers
505 S. Vulcan Ave
Encinitas, California 92024
Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the Commission.
1.
CALL TO ORDER
2.
ROLL CALL
3.
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE
4.
SPECIAL PRESENTATIONS AND PROCLAMATIONS None
5.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS / POSSIBLE DIRECTION TO STAFF Each speaker has three (3) minutes to address the Commission for the Arts using the New Public Comment Procedures outlined above. If needed, Oral Communication items will be referred to City Staff either for resolution by administrative action or placement on a future agenda.
6.
CHANGES TO THE AGENDA Announce administrative changes to the agenda in compliance with the Brown Act.
7.
APPROVAL OF THE MINUTES
Approve the August 1, 2022 Regular Meeting Minutes.
August 1, 2022 Regular Meeting Minutes

8A.
Pacific View Programming Update.
Review the presented information, invite public comment, and provide feedback.
8A. Pacific View Programming Update
8B.
El Portal Mosaic Artist Recommendation.
Review the ad hoc committee selection and make a recommendation to the City Council to award the contract for the El Portal Undercrossing Public Art project.
8B. El Portal Mosaic Artist Recommendation
8C.
Commission for the Arts Annual Work Plan.
Review the FY 2022/23 Work Plan and report on progress.
8C. Commission for the Arts Annual Work Plan

9A.
Cultural Arts Division Report – Arts Administrator Murphy
9B.
Commission Calendar -- Arts Administrator Murphy

Wednesdays@Noon concerts: September 14, 21, and 28, Encinitas Library

Encinitas Friends of the Arts Report – Commissioner Valenzuela
